edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom calls ensure() to authorize the transfer
ensure() calls condition() when sender is not whitelisted
transferFrom mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic
batchSend multiplies and subtracts without overflow checks
delegate() performs delegatecall on an arbitrary user-supplied address
callOptionalReturn executes a low-level call with caller-derived data
external token contract can execute arbitrary code during the low-level call
msg.sender determines the allowance spender and caller identity used in transferFrom
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before delegatecall
_mints() gates minting on msg.sender being owner or backdoor address
init() requires msg.sender == owner
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
approve() writes allowance for msg.sender
transfer() moves funds from msg.sender
_from parameter selects the source account in transferFrom
_to parameter selects the destination account in transferFrom
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom
_tos array drives the batchSend transfer loop
_value amount is used for total and per-recipient credits in batchSend
a is the target address of the delegatecall in delegate()
b is the arbitrary calldata passed into the delegatecall
spender is the minted-to account in _mints()
addedValue determines the minted balance in _mints()
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for both parties
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without overflow checks
ensure() whitelists the owner address
ensure() whitelists tradeAddress
ensure() whitelists addresses with canSale set
ensure() whitelists the UNI constant address
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound
condition() enforces the _saleNum limit
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true
_mints() assigns the minted amount to balanceOf[spender]
init() sets _minSale
init() sets _maxSale
init() sets _saleNum
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied supply
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor grants infinite allowance to the router address
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
